Title: Define OpenAPI v1 baseline
Description:
Create `openapi.yaml` for critical endpoints: health, waitlist, checkout, subscription status, Lemon webhook, AI coach.

Acceptance criteria:
- `openapi.yaml` exists in repo
- Critical endpoints include request/response schemas
- Success and error examples are documented

Title: Standardize API error format
Description:
Implement a single error response shape: `{ code, message, details?, requestId }` across endpoints.

Acceptance criteria:
- All endpoints return the standard error shape
- OpenAPI documents the shape
- Frontend consumes `code` consistently

Title: Add requestId propagation
Description:
Generate a request identifier per HTTP request and propagate it in responses and logs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every response includes `requestId`
- Server logs include the same `requestId`
- Request tracing works end-to-end

Title: Setup CI workflow
Description:
Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to run tests and basic checks on pull requests and pushes.

Acceptance criteria:
- CI runs on push and pull request
- `npm test` passes in `comfort-ledger-beta`
- Failing checks block merge

Title: Add predeploy validation script
Description:
Create `npm run predeploy:check` to validate critical env vars and release prerequisites.

Acceptance criteria:
- Script fails when critical secrets are missing
- Checks include session secret and Lemon webhook secret when purchase mode is enabled
- Release checklist references script

Title: Design data schema v1
Description:
Define relational schema for users, sessions, waitlist, subscriptions, and webhook events.

Acceptance criteria:
- Schema document exists
- Tables and key indexes are defined
- Migration approach is documented

Title: Implement data access layer
Description:
Replace direct JSON file access with repository/data-access layer backed by database.

Acceptance criteria:
- Critical endpoints use repository layer
- Migrated entities no longer rely on JSON writes
- Integration smoke tests pass

Title: Build JSON-to-DB migration script
Description:
Create idempotent migration script for beta users, sessions, waitlist, and subscriptions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Script is idempotent
- Migration report shows counts and failures
- Dry-run mode is available

Title: Document rollback procedure
Description:
Write and validate rollback plan for failed data migration in staging.

Acceptance criteria:
- Rollback document exists
- Staging rollback rehearsal completed
- Backups are required before production migration

Title: Add webhook idempotency
Description:
Store and deduplicate Lemon webhook event IDs to prevent double-processing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Duplicate events do not mutate state twice
- Event processing states are tracked as processed, duplicate, or failed
- Automated test covers replay

Title: Create subscription reconciliation job
Description:
Implement periodic reconciliation between Lemon subscription state and local records.

Acceptance criteria:
- Manual or scheduled reconcile command exists
- Mismatches are reported
- Mismatches can be corrected safely

Title: Harden payment-related endpoints
Description:
Apply strict email validation, endpoint-specific rate limits, and safe error responses for checkout and portal paths.

Acceptance criteria:
- Rate limits are enforced on checkout and portal endpoints
- Invalid emails are rejected consistently
- Responses do not leak sensitive information

Title: Add critical API integration tests
Description:
Create integration tests for login, waitlist, checkout creation, subscription status, and webhook flows.

Acceptance criteria:
- Integration suite runs in CI
- Success and failure paths are covered
- Security-sensitive behaviors are verified

Title: Add E2E paid-user flow
Description:
Automate end-to-end scenario from landing to app access for paying users using staged webhook/payment mocks.

Acceptance criteria:
- E2E test validates onboarding to paid access
- Test is deterministic in CI or pre-release environment

Title: Add E2E beta-tester flow
Description:
Automate end-to-end scenario for beta login, core app usage, session persistence, and logout.

Acceptance criteria:
- E2E test validates protected routes, session continuity, and logout behavior
- Test runs in CI

Title: Implement structured JSON logging
Description:
Adopt structured logs with fields such as level, message, requestId, endpoint, and latency.

Acceptance criteria:
- Logs are emitted as JSON
- Sensitive data is redacted
- Request-linked debugging is possible in runtime logs

Title: Add minimal alerting and SLO signals
Description:
Set alerts for 5xx rate, webhook failures, and high latency p95 with actionable thresholds.

Acceptance criteria:
- Alert thresholds are defined and deployed
- Alert simulation confirms delivery
- Runbook references alert handling

Title: Write incident runbook v1
Description:
Document response procedures for login outages, webhook failures, and payment access incidents.

Acceptance criteria:
- Runbook exists in repo
- Includes detection, mitigation, communication, and recovery steps
- On-call checklist is included

Title: Version public API under /v1
Description:
Introduce API version prefix and migrate current routes to `/v1` while preserving behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- Public routes are available under `/v1`
- Docs are updated
- Compatibility checks confirm no regressions

Title: Implement basic RBAC roles
Description:
Add base roles `admin`, `support`, and `user` and restrict administrative endpoints by role.

Acceptance criteria:
- Role model is persisted and enforced
- Protected endpoints require expected role
- Authorization tests pass

Title: Define API compatibility policy
Description:
Create policy for backward compatibility, deprecation windows, and breaking-change process.

Acceptance criteria:
- Policy document is in repo
- Pull request template references the policy
- Breaking-change checklist is enforceable
